dataOwnership: Booking owns quote, hold, reservation, amendment/cancellation state, inventory release, attribution, and immutable commercial/policy snapshots; Finance owns deposit, receivable, refund, and waiver obligations.

Reservation CONFIRMED may become CANCELLED using one unexpired matching quote; checked-in uses separate early-termination path.
Refund obligation state never changes Booking back from CANCELLED.

failureSemantics: Reject invalid/unauthorized lifecycle commands before changing booking or inventory and never infer financial verification from a client flag.
Map quote expiry, hold expiry, inventory conflict, stale revision, policy quote stale, finance unavailable, and idempotency mismatch to distinct stable codes.
Retry only transient internal/event delivery work; business conflicts require a refreshed authoritative revision.

Use aggregate version compare-and-swap so concurrent writers produce one winner and a stable conflict for losers.
Deduplicate consumed events by event ID and business key.

additions.actor: Authorized backoffice operator or trusted ViStay service
additions.outcome: Finance Service reconciles deposit assessments, payment allocations, amendment deltas, cancellation obligations and Booking snapshots through an explicit repair queue.
additions.context: Use Booking authorization/reconciliation contract and local financial ledgers. Do not mutate Booking rows or infer reservation state from a payment provider webhook alone.
inScope: Detect final Booking state without expected current obligation, obligation with mismatched booking snapshot/version, duplicate allocation, refund/receivable amount mismatch, and exhausted event consumption.
Record cases with financial/booking revisions and expose SYSTEM-only scan/repair/retry/quarantine commands.
Repair Finance-owned projections and compensating obligations idempotently; request Booking resync for Booking-owned mismatch.
Emit bounded metrics and redacted audit evidence.
outOfScope: Frontend rendering outside the owning service contract.
Direct reads from another service database.
Production credentials, destructive history rewrites, or silent fallback authorization.
interfaces: Expose only the operations named in this issue through the owning GraphQL or gRPC boundary.
Return stable validation, forbidden, not-found, conflict, and dependency-unavailable codes.
Persist an outbox event in the same transaction for every externally observable state change.
dataOwnership: Finance owns versioned deposit/waiver decisions, payment verification, receivable/refund obligations, allocations, and financial reconciliation; Booking owns reservation state and immutable commercial snapshots.
stateMachine: Case is OPEN -> REPAIRING -> RESOLVED, WAITING_BOOKING, RETRY_WAIT, or QUARANTINED.
Collected/refunded facts are append-only; repair creates missing projection/allocation/compensation, never edits provider truth.
Booking-owned mismatch becomes WAITING_BOOKING with required revision evidence.

dataPartitions: CUSTOMER_SELF for owned reservation reads/cancellation requests; ADMIN organization plus assigned employee or SITE/BRANCH for backoffice commands; SYSTEM only for authenticated reconciliation.
fieldGroups: RESERVATION_SUMMARY is baseline; FINANCIAL, PII, TRUST_DETAIL, CANCELLATION_DETAIL, and INTERNAL_AUDIT require explicit grants.

failureSemantics: Fail closed when Booking authorization record, effective rule version, payment verification, or trust decision is unavailable.
Return stable not-found, forbidden, stale-version, obligation-conflict, and dependency-unavailable codes without exposing payment credentials.
Use append-only obligation revisions and compensating records; never rewrite a collected/refunded amount.
idempotencyConcurrency: Require an idempotency key for commands that can be retried externally and persist its request fingerprint and result.
Use aggregate version compare-and-swap so concurrent writers produce one winner and a stable conflict for losers.
Deduplicate consumed events by event ID and business key.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a seeded Finance-owned reservation obligation mismatch
acceptanceCriteria.then: one case converges local obligations/allocations with append-only evidence

acceptanceCriteria.given: Booking revision mismatch, provider uncertainty, or dependency failure
acceptanceCriteria.then: the case waits/retries/quarantines and no payment/refund finality is invented

acceptanceCriteria.given: events or repair commands replay
acceptanceCriteria.then: one financial effect/case resolution remains and audit evidence is stable

tests: Run the focused Gradle test selection with Testcontainers for PostgreSQL where persistence is involved.
Prove both the authorized path and action/partition/field-group denial path; retain the XML test report in Jira evidence.
Replay the same idempotency key and expected version and assert exactly one persisted business effect.

additions.summary: [VS-E08-T05] Publish quote hold reservation and cancellation contracts
additions.actor: ViStay implementation engineer or release operator
additions.outcome: Platform Contracts publishes versioned quote, hold, confirmation, amendment, cancellation and Booking–Finance decision/reconciliation contracts with explicit ownership and stable errors.
additions.context: Pricing/inventory/payment primitives exist, but the end-to-end reservation lifecycle contract does not. Define boundaries before service/UI implementation and keep monetary policy values external.
inScope: Add backoffice reservation GraphQL types/operations and Booking–Finance gRPC decision/reconciliation messages.
Add reservation lifecycle, amendment, cancellation-requested, and obligation-decision v1 events/examples.
Specify immutable snapshot/fingerprint, quote expiry, non-extending hold, final financial gate, material-change reassessment, cancellation preview expiry/formula, and stable error codes.
Validate composition, protobuf architecture, event privacy, and negative fixtures.
outOfScope: Runtime business logic owned by another repository.
Production secrets or unapproved policy values.
Changing historical Jira workflow or bypassing the catalog readiness gate.
interfaces: Version every externally consumed operation or event and state its owner, caller, compatibility rule, timeout, and stable error behavior.
Keep fixtures deterministic and free of production credentials or customer data.
dataOwnership: This task owns only the named contract, UI, or infrastructure artifacts; authoritative domain rows remain in their service database.
stateMachine: Artifact lifecycle is DRAFT -> VALIDATED -> PUBLISHED; an incompatible semantic change requires a new version.
A failed validation remains unpublished and produces an actionable diagnostic.
Rollback selects the last validated artifact and does not mutate its contents.

dataPartitions: SYSTEM contract catalogue or the explicit ADMIN SITE/BRANCH partition used by the tested operation.
fieldGroups: SUMMARY by default; DOCUMENT, PII, and INTERNAL_AUDIT appear only in explicitly granted test cases.

failureSemantics: Fail validation or startup when a required contract, environment value, or dependency is absent.
Never print tokens, presigned URLs, private document fields, or production values in test output.
Use stable assertion messages so a weak agent can locate the failing contract or scenario.
idempotencyConcurrency: Fixtures use unique deterministic business keys and cleanup is safe to repeat.
Repeated publication of identical canonical input produces the same fingerprint.
Concurrent API examples assert one effect or an explicit conflict.
